description: 2001 is the Year of the Metal Snake in the Chinese zodiac, from January 24, 2001 to February 11, 2002. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2001 is the Year of the Metal Snake, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 24, 2001 and ended on February 11, 2002, so people born in 2001 before Jan 24 belong to the Metal Dragon year.

sections.heading: 2001 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Metal Snake year on January 24, 2001, and the year ran to February 11, 2002. So a birth date of Jan 24, 2001 or later counts as Metal Snake, and so do early 2002 birthdays through Feb 11; births in 2001 before Jan 24 still belong to the Metal Dragon. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1941 are Metal Snake years too. That Wednesday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Metal Snake is like
paragraphs: People born in a Metal Snake year are often pictured as quietly formidable: elegant, independent and patient in pursuit of a goal. Fire controlling Metal is read as warmth spent on refinement. They choose allies carefully and rarely waste words. Readings suggest that asking for help in small ways, and agreeing on when work is finished, brings them closer to others.

Belonging to the west and to the clear, cool air of autumn, Metal adds edge, resolve and structure to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with righteousness, strength of will and the ability to see a situation without sentiment. A Metal stem often makes an animal more ambitious, more organised and more self-contained than usual. People born in Metal years are frequently described as loyal to their word and tireless once committed. The caution most readings add is a hardness that can isolate them, along with perfectionism and a reluctance to admit doubt or ask for help.

sections.heading: 2001 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the digits of this year reduce to 3, associated with expression, creativity and sociability, so a 3 year is described as lively and communicative. The digits of 2001 add up to 3. The Snake holds the sixth place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Fire. Set beside the year's Metal stem, fire controls Metal, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Metal Dragon and the year after is the Water Horse.

Chinese almanacs name 2001 Xin-Si, pairing the Metal stem Xin with the branch Si. Both are Yin, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2001?
faq.answer: 2001 is the Year of the Metal Snake. It started on January 24, 2001 and ended on February 11, 2002.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2001?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 24. Born before January 24, 2001, you are a Metal Dragon; born on or after it, you are a Metal Snake.

faq.question: What element is 2001 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Metal, a Yin year. The Snake's own fixed element is Fire; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2001?
faq.answer: Xin-Si. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Metal Snake year?
faq.answer: 2061, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1941.
